frontmatter.title: Jobee - Job Search App
frontmatter.subheading: RESTful API and Platform for Job Seekers and Employers
frontmatter.excerpt: Comprehensive job search platform, implemented as a RESTful API. It's built using Node.js, Express.js, and MongoDB, with a focus on performance, reliability, and scalability. The API supports a wide array of features, including advanced search filters, authentication, and file uploads, among others.
frontmatter.type: RESTful API and Platform for Job Seekers and Employers
